hero.label: Optimal revenue
hero.verdict: The model identifies high-elasticity windows worth investing in. Increasing promo spend by 2933516.5× unlocks 10% more revenue. The commercial case is volume growth: more targeted investment, more turnover.
hero.data_sub: Trained on 2 years of causal data (2024–2025) · 10 SKUs selected

why_reasons.title: Top 3 SKUs account for 59% of portfolio opportunity
why_reasons.body: HX9914/61, HX9911/89, HX9992/12 together drive 59% of the total revenue uplift (+765,531.19 €). Concentrate promo investment on these for highest impact.

why_reasons.title: Weeks 39–51 are your highest-elasticity window
why_reasons.body: The causal model shows strongest price response in weeks 39–51 — 661,035.62 € incremental revenue available here. Concentrate promo activity in this window.

why_reasons.title: Optimal depth averages 12% across the portfolio
why_reasons.body: The causal response curve is concave — beyond 12% discount, additional depth adds cost without meaningful volume gain.
